answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to stake a unique physical-unclonable token, akin to locking a Rb-87 optical lattice clock to a single sub-Doppler Sisyphus cooling trajectory that no adversary can replicate across an ocean of spoofed nodes. Registration binds the token to a comet-like transient nonce, so any attempt to forge a duplicate. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
